About

Still growing, still building

I'm a computer engineering student who likes taking things apart to see how they work — a sorting algorithm, a machine learning model, a messy spreadsheet of data. Somewhere between structuring code and studying certificates, I found I enjoy the process of learning new tools almost as much as using them.

I've since taken that curiosity into two internships, four independent projects, and a spot in Amazon's ML Summer School 2026 — while continuing to build on data structures, full-stack development, and applied AI/ML through the courses and simulations you'll find below.
